simple.meaning: רָצָה (râtsâh) appears 57 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with flocks and in connection with kingship. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering and divine acceptance.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 33:10. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, offering, sacrifice, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָצָה (H7521) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows רָצָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: רָצָה (râtsâh) / H7521 is tracked through Genesis 33:10, Leviticus 1:4, Leviticus 7:18, Leviticus 19:7. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
